Walkthrough

3/4 - 3/9

3/4

You arrive at the Harbor. Once you have control, the shops nearby are open and you have 5 new requests.

Some of them repeat.
The first needs junk you could not sell before. It drops in the old warehouse. Do all of these: the rewards are worth it.

3/5

Another investigation. Talk to these people, in any order:

  • The crowd by the notice board.
  • The man outside the chandler.
  • The sailor near the pier

That is it. Head back to the ship.

3/6

After the scenes, go to the marker to enter the cave.

The cave

A fight starts at the entrance. A chest sits on a ledge west of it.

EnemyWeak to
SlimeFire
BatWind

3/7

A free day. Spend it on the requests you left.
